name: Yap MCP
description: Transcribes audio and video files on your computer with NVIDIA Parakeet TDT v3 (25 European languages, no API key, no upload) and searches your Yap dictation history. MIT licensed. Install: `claude mcp add yap -- npx -y github:founden-bot/yap-mcp` · [Website](https://yapapp.cc/mcp)
